fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn from_k(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 1)
  ensures (result >= k)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (from_k([1, 2, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (from_k([], 1) == 1)
  example (from_k([2], 1) == 1)
  example (from_k([1, 2, 3], 2) == 4)
{
  if has(xs, k) then from_k(xs, (k + 1)) else k
}

fn first_missing(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x >= 1)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in 1..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([1, 1, 2]) == 3)
{
  from_k(xs, 1)
}

  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (lo >= 0)
  requires (lo < hi)
  requires ((lo * lo) <= n)

  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (lo >= 0)
  requires (lo < hi)
  requires ((lo * lo) <= n)
  requires ((hi * hi) > n)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure
  example (sqrt_search(0, 0, 1) == 0)
  example (sqrt_search(1, 0, 2) == 1)
  example (sqrt_search(16, 0, 17) == 4)
  example (sqrt_search(17, 0, 18) == 4)
  example (sqrt_search(15, 0, 16) == 3)
{
  if ((hi - lo) <= 1) then lo else if ((((lo + hi) / 2) * ((lo + hi) / 2)) <= n) then sqrt_search(n, lo, ((lo + hi) / 2)) else sqrt_search(n, ((lo + hi) / 2), hi)
}

fn int_sqrt(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)

  effects pure

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (2 * len(xs)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((result[(2 * i)] == xs[i]) and (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [g, ..s] => ([h, g] ++ interleave(t, s)) } }
}

  requires (a != b)
  ensures ((result == a) or (result == b))
  ensures ((result <= a) and (result <= b))
  effects pure
  example (min2(3, 5) == 3)
  example (min2(5, 3) == 3)
  example (min2(0, 7) == 0)
{
  if (a <= b) then a else b
}

fn min_of(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (result <= x)
  effects pure
  example (min_of([7, 2, 9, 4]) == 2)
  example (min_of([5]) == 5)
  example (min_of([3, 8]) == 3)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => h [_, ..r] => min2(h, min_of(t)) } }
}

fn remove_one(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires contains(xs, v)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  ensures not contains(result, v)
  ensures distinct(result)
  effects pure
  example (remove_one([7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == [7, 9, 4])
  example (remove_one([3], 3) == [])
  example (remove_one([1, 5], 5) == [1])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then t else ([h] ++ remove_one(t, v)) }
}

fn count_less(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (count_less([7, 2, 9, 4], 5) == 2)
  example (count_less([], 1) == 0)
  example (count_less([3, 1], 0) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h < v) then (1 + count_less(t, v)) else count_less(t, v) }
}

fn kth_smallest(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires ((k >= 1) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (count_less(xs, result) == (k - 1))
  effects pure
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (kth_smallest([5], 1) == 5)
{
  if (k == 1) then min_of(xs) else kth_smallest(remove_one(xs, min_of(xs)), (k - 1))
}

  ensures forall y in ys: ((not is_majority(xs, y)) or (result == Some(y)))
  ensures match result { None => true Some(v) => (is_majority(xs, v) and contains(ys, v)) }
  effects pure
  example (first_majority([3, 1, 3, 3], [3, 1, 3, 3]) == Some(3))
  example (first_majority([1, 2], [1, 2]) == None)
  example (first_majority([], []) == None)
{
  match ys { [] => None [h, ..t] => if is_majority(xs, h) then Some(h) else first_majority(xs, t) }
}

fn sum_first(xs: List[Int], n: Int) -> Int
  requires ((n >= 0) and (n <= len(xs)))
  ensures (((n == 0) and (result == 0)) or ((n > 0) and (result == (xs[(n - 1)] + sum_first(xs, (n - 1))))))
  effects pure
  example (sum_first([1, 2, 3], 0) == 0)
  example (sum_first([1, 2, 3], 2) == 3)
  example (sum_first([1, 2, 3], 3) == 6)
{
  if (n == 0) then 0 else match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => (h + sum_first(t, (n - 1))) }
}

fn running(xs: List[Int], acc: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (running([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (running([], 5) == [])
  example (running([4], 10) == [14])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([(acc + h)] ++ running(t, (acc + h))) }
}

fn prefix_sums(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == sum_first(xs, (i + 1)))
  effects pure
  example (prefix_sums([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (prefix_sums([]) == [])
  example (prefix_sums([5]) == [5])
{
  running(xs, 0)
}

  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (skip_front([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (skip_front([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (skip_front([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k != 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => skip_front(t, (k - 1)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) == (result == None))
  effects pure

  example (max_opt([3, 9, 1]) == Some(9))
  example (max_opt([4]) == Some(4))
{

  ensures forall x in result: (x < m)

  example (below([4], 4) == [])
  example (below([], 0) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h < m) then ([h] ++ below(t, m)) else below(t, m) }

  requires distinct(xs)

  match max_opt(xs) { None => None Some(m) => max_opt(below(xs, m)) }
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [7]) == [12])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [k, ..u] => ([(h + k)] ++ zip_sum(t, u)) } }
}
